Physicists at the Large Hadron Collider just got their first glimpse into the zeptoverse—the subatomic realm of a sextillionth of a meter! But what if we could actually build technology at this microscopic scale? In the zeptoverse, quantum fluctuations dominate and quarks interact in fractions of a zeptosecond. Engineering down here could let us manipulate matter particle by particle, creating ultra-dense energy storage or self-healing materials. Could zeptoscale tech revolutionize our future?
